content:
I'm looking for clarification on the verification time limit mentioned here. It sounds like the time limit is 5.5 hours but also says "A ten-hour submission can be retried by running the same trusted workflow on a worker with the required lifetime; lack of such a worker leaves verification inconclusive rather than changing what Palomar accepts." I don't understand this. Under what circumstances does the higher 10 hour time limit apply?

A repo that I'm going to attempt to register shortly takes about 8 hours to compile so this distinction is very pertinent to me!

Yeah, sorry, that is nonsense, I will have to investigate tomorrow. Any submission which you expect to take more than 5 hours on a standard github runner, please don't bother submitting for now: but please tell me about them!

I am trying to provision some larger/faster runners for Palomar, but have hit some technical problems. (Thanks Lean FRO for putting up the money that means we can pay for them once I make them work. :-)
Good to know. I'll see if some optimization from my agent can get it under the bar :)
